# Artwork

Outside of machine learning and data, I paint and draw as a way to unplug and recharge. This page is a growing gallery of my work — click on any piece to view it in full size.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  document.querySelectorAll('.art-carousel').forEach(function (carousel) {
    var track = carousel.querySelector('.art-carousel-track');
    var slides = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.children);
    var total = slides.length;
    if (total < 2) return;

    var intervalMs = parseInt(carousel.dataset.interval, 10) || 5000;

    var clone = slides[0].cloneNode(true);
    clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    track.appendChild(clone);

    var slideBasis = 100 / (total + 1);
    track.style.width = (total + 1) * 100 + '%';
    Array.prototype.slice.call(track.children).forEach(function (slide) {
      slide.style.flex = '0 0 ' + slideBasis + '%';
    });

    var dotsWrap = carousel.querySelector('.art-carousel-dots');
    var dots = slides.map(function (_, i) {
      var dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.type = 'button';
      dot.className = 'art-carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', function () {
        index = i;
        apply(true);
        setActiveDot(index);
        restart();
      });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
      return dot;
    });

    var index = 0;
    var timer = null;

    function setActiveDot(i) {
      dots.forEach(function (d, di) { d.classList.toggle('is-active', di === (((i % total) + total) % total)); });
    }

    function apply(withTransition) {
      track.style.transition = withTransition ? '' : 'none';
      var pct = -index * slideBasis;
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + pct + '%)';
    }

    function next() {
      index++;
      apply(true);
      setActiveDot(index);
      if (index === total) {
        track.addEventListener('transitionend', function handler() {
          track.removeEventListener('transitionend', handler);
          index = 0;
          apply(false);
          void track.offsetWidth;
        });
      }
    }

    function prev() {
      if (index === 0) {
        index = total;
        apply(false);
        void track.offsetWidth;
      }
      index--;
      apply(true);
      setActiveDot(index);
    }

    function play() {
      if (reduceMotion) return;
      stop();
      timer = setInterval(next, intervalMs);
    }
    function stop() {
      if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
    }
    function restart() { stop(); play(); }

    carousel.querySelector('.art-carousel-next').addEventListener('click', function () { next(); restart(); });
    carousel.querySelector('.art-carousel-prev').addEventListener('click', function () { prev(); restart(); });
    carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
    carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', play);
    carousel.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
    carousel.addEventListener('focusout', play);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
      if (document.hidden) stop(); else play();
    });

    apply(false);
    play();
  });
})();
</script>
```
